findings.title: Inaccurate claim that handleBarcodeSubmit computes master in scope
findings.detail: Only handleProductTap and the two grid onPress blocks (~2247, ~2294) compute baseId/master. handleBarcodeSubmit runs its own master/uom loop. Non-load-bearing because the barcode path is refactored to shared findProductByBarcode (returns variant?).
findings.fix: Reword: grid branches compute master in scope; handleBarcodeSubmit is refactored to findProductByBarcode which returns { product, uom, variant? }.

findings.title: Kiosk barcode-exclusion arg not stated explicitly
findings.detail: Kiosk calls findProductByBarcode(barcode, MOCK_PRODUCTS) with the full list. To exclude variant products from barcode match, the filtered array must be passed in.
findings.fix: Pass the same !(m.variants && m.variants.length) filtered array into findProductByBarcode and build ALL_PRODUCTS from it.

findings.title: Kiosk retains its own local 2-arg toCartProduct
findings.detail: Kiosk has a local toCartProduct(master, uom) not migrated to the shared helper. Correct given kiosk is out of scope for variants, but not stated.
findings.fix: Add a line: kiosk keeps its existing local toCartProduct and is not migrated.
